ttl_minutes.title: Lock lifetime (minutes)
ttl_minutes.description: How long the shown price is honoured.

on_expired.title: Expired lock
on_expired.description: reprice: the line is priced with today's deals (the quote lists it as stale); reject: the quote fails with price_lock_expired.

on_base_price_change.title: Base price changed since the lock
on_base_price_change.description: honor: keep the locked price (never above the new list price); reprice: drop the lock.

prefer_better_live_price.title: A better live price beats the lock

grace_seconds.title: Grace after expiry (seconds)
grace_seconds.description: Tolerated delay between the shopper's last step and the quote.

issue_on_offers.title: Issue locks with item offers
issue_on_offers.description: Product pages get a lock with every offer (for 'add to cart').

bind_to_customer.title: Bind locks to the identified customer

max_units.title: Units a lock covers (offers)
max_units.description: Cart quotes lock the quoted quantity.
